title: MeitY notifies IT Intermediary Amendment Rules 2026: 3-hour takedown window
summary: MeitY notified IT Rules 2026 under Section 87 IT Act 2000 reducing lawful order takedown from 36 hours to 3 hours, grievance acknowledgement to 7 days.
